notes.title: Update Notes for Manzaka: Community-Driven Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831356/91342d55d7e119083b4d4c834d0381466c468258.jpg[/img]
Thank you all for your invaluable feedback! Your suggestions have helped shape these updates, making Manzaka even better. We’re committed to continuously improving the game, and here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Chest Storage Adjustments: Opening the Crafting screen will now automatically close the Chest Storage, preventing background interactions with wires. (Feedback from supvalentinolove)
[*] Character Animations: The Main Character now features distinct idle and running animations when not holding a weapon. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Improved Floor Contact: The Main Character now visually connects with the floor for a more immersive experience.
[*] Crafting Screen Hotkey: You can now press the C key to open and close the crafting screen. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] TAB Functionality: Pressing TAB in the inventory will also close the crafting screen. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Crafting Slot Feedback: When items are removed from the top crafting slot, it will once again display "This one maintains the passives." (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Inventory Stat Sensitivity: Stats in the inventory screen now have improved sensitivity. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Resistance Display: Resistances will now appear in the inventory stats even if currently at 0. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Faster Map Assembly: Maps will now assemble more quickly. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Tutorial Fixes: Removed the flashing geometry in the tutorial where floor tiles intersected. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Map Portal Interactions: Portals now require interaction to trigger and move you to the next area. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Lord of Shadows Fix: The Shield Charge ability of the Lord of Shadows no longer deals instant damage. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Text Revisions: Updated tutorial, item descriptions, and passive descriptions for clarity. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Shield Stat Display: Shields now avoid displaying stats that are already shown in the item's base stats. (Feedback from Aru)
[*] Shield Adjustments: The Wood Shield and Knight Shield have been rebalanced from scaling physical resistance to providing a flat 1 physical resist. (Feedback from JaviElGrande)
[*] General Shield Improvements: All shields have been rebalanced, with particular improvements to green shields. (Feedback from JaviElGrande)
[/list]

Thank you once again for helping us refine Manzaka. Your continued support means the world to us!

notes.title: Manzaka: Golden Army
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831356/4951bacb7ea65e3ee1e3f4e649edf4e992f30bf0.png[/img]

In a mystical world teetering on the edge of balance, an ancient force of darkness awakens, threatening to engulf everything in shadow. As cities fall and hope fades, the gods intervene, choosing a mortal champion to combat this evil. Guided by divine powers, the champion embarks on a quest to summon the Golden Army—a legion of celestial warriors from an ancient prophecy. In an epic final battle, the champion and the Golden Army confront the darkness, ultimately sealing it away at great personal cost. With the darkness vanquished, the world begins to heal, and the champion's heroic legacy endures, promising hope for future generations.
